display_name: LoRa W24 固定方向的逐包分区幅度估计
description: Test whether receiver-observable gain along a fixed learned direction improves held waveforms and source truth-last accuracy.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.environment: Ordinary N607 account, explicit approved GPU capacity or two-thread CPU fallback; frozen archive CPU E104 independent evaluation.
code.cwd: Immutable source release for gain fit; archived W24 release for CPU prediction and scoring.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: First 800 per receiver from the pre-existing 4,000/rx U fit order, original separate 500 U held IDs, and the fixed original 300 V panel.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Only frozen source weights, U_s IQ and same-source simulated pairs for gain estimation; no W24, V, TX or target before freeze. Oracle only in isolated source V column.

checkpoint.initialization: Freeze exact-additive and 24,000-step fixed-dose direction weights; fit only two weighted ridge gain models from scratch.

sources.role: Exact terminal frozen 24,000 update direction head and original optimizer budget.
Fixed source-only Practical exact-additive 24000 update checkpoint for both readouts.
Independent source evaluation after direction checkpoint freeze.
Identical source V physical IDs and first three independently scored reference predictions.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact r01 current terminal checkpoint, original parent, E104 readout, 300 source V IDs and endpoint parity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen parent of the same LoRa source contract; original source-only checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: One deterministic freeze. Adaptive gain must improve >=18 merged correct, positive paired lower bound, >=6 low urban and preserve source direct clean versus fixed-dose direction; also must beat the constant six-view control. Oracle never eligible.

execution.gpu_policy: One eligible GPU prioritized 7,0,3,6,5; else start two-thread CPU immediately. Source prediction two CPU threads and two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Binding, no-query smoke, nonfinite fit, baseline prediction parity or truth-last closure failure; retain outputs and preserve other owners.

rows.method: One full-packet phase and IQ direction head with separate hard pre-RMS center and edge norms
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.budget_ref: 4,000 paired U_s source physical packets plus their identity views, 500 held. One fit, 300 source V x seven views x six readouts.

notes: Receive-only observable features: outer/shoulder spectral medians, adjacent chirp coherence, regional power, edit ratio, and received/edit alignment.
Same frozen correction directions with per-region bounded gain [0,1.75]. Fixed intercept control shares the same WLS fit support.
Source reference projected on the frozen actual learned direction supplies the gain target; separate exact least-squares amplitude source diagnostic keeps clean at the fixed direction output.
